verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published tokens-per-second figures, latency numbers, benchmark results, or load-testing guides. The closest items are adjacent: vague claims like "no provisioning latency" and "Better performance" for dedicated endpoints, a provisioned-throughput commitment to unspecified "throughput and reliability targets", and one anecdotal community mention of "good speed". None of these is a published speed number or benchmarking guide.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
